name: Nattawat Jirochtikul
description: '''Nattawat Jirochtikul''' ({{langx|th|ณัฐวรรธน์ จิโรชน์ธิกุล}}; born 18 October 2004), nicknamed '''Fourth''' ({{langx|th|โฟร์ท}}), is a Thai actor under [[GMMTV]] and a singer signed to [[Riser Music]]. He began his career after winning the talent competition ''Thailand School Star 2019''. In 2021, he made his acting debut as Glakao in ''[[F4 Thailand: Boys Over Flowers]]'', the Thai adaptation of the Japanese manga series ''[[Boys Over Flowers]]''. He rose to prominence for his lead role as Gun in the popular television series ''[[My School President]]'' (2022) and as Li Ming in ''[[Moonlight Chicken]]'' (2023).
